description: HEADLESS: claude exposes -p/--print for non-interactive CI use — the pipeline runs the agent headless, not in a REPL
command: claude --help 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq '\-p, --print' && echo pass || echo fail

description: HEADLESS: claude exposes --output-format json — the pipeline gets a machine-parseable result to gate on, not free text
command: claude --help 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq 'output-format' && echo pass || echo fail

description: HEADLESS: claude exposes --json-schema — structured output can be constrained to a release-verdict contract the pipeline validates
command: claude --help 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq 'json-schema' && echo pass || echo fail

description: HERMETIC: claude exposes --bare (skip hooks/LSP/plugins) — the analysis runs without project context for a reproducible, hermetic verdict
command: claude --help 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq '\-\-bare' && echo pass || echo fail

description: SCHEMA: the release-verdict JSON schema exists — the output contract the hermetic analysis is bound to (verdict + blockers + evidence)
command: jq -e '.properties.verdict.enum | index("block")' contracts/release-verdict.schema.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail

description: PIPELINE: pipeline-analyze.sh exists and is executable — the deterministic reference for what the in-CI agent analysis produces
command: [ -x scripts/pipeline-analyze.sh ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: LEAST PRIVILEGE: the pipeline analyzer contains no cluster/infra write command — the agent in CI analyzes, it never applies (no kubectl apply / helm upgrade / terraform apply / docker push)
command: ! sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]*#.*$//' scripts/pipeline-analyze.sh | grep -Eq '(kubectl[[:space:]]+(apply|delete|scale|patch)|helm[[:space:]]+(upgrade|install)|terraform[[:space:]]+apply|docker[[:space:]]+push)' && echo pass || echo fail

description: GATE: pipeline-analyze BLOCKS the v1.2.0 release candidate — the candidate's readiness probe (/health) is not a route the app serves, caught from executable evidence
command: [ -f fixtures/release/candidate-values.yaml ] || { echo missing-candidate; exit 0; }; bash scripts/pipeline-analyze.sh --values fixtures/release/candidate-values.yaml --field verdict 2>/dev/null

description: GATE EVIDENCE: the block reason names the readiness mismatch — the probe path is checked against the routes the app ACTUALLY serves, not a doc claim
command: [ -f fixtures/release/candidate-values.yaml ] || { echo fail; exit 0; }; bash scripts/pipeline-analyze.sh --values fixtures/release/candidate-values.yaml --field blockers 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq 'readiness: probe path /health is not a route the app serves' && echo pass || echo fail

description: GATE IS NOT A RUBBER STAMP: the same analyzer run against the repaired chart on main returns approve — the gate blocks the candidate on evidence, not because it blocks everything
command: bash scripts/pipeline-analyze.sh --field verdict 2>/dev/null

description: SEPARATION OF DUTIES: the change-reviewer identity has no Edit/Write tool — the agent that approves cannot be the agent that authored the change
command: grep -Eq 'disallowedTools: \[.*"Edit".*"Write"' .claude/agents/change-reviewer.md && echo pass || echo fail

description: SEPARATION OF DUTIES: the platform-engineer proposer is Git-only — its description forbids applying to the cluster, so it proposes but cannot merge or deploy
command: grep -Eiq 'never|git-only' .claude/agents/platform-engineer.md && grep -Eq 'gitops-propose|propose' .claude/agents/platform-engineer.md 2>/dev/null; grep -Eiq 'NEVER .*(applies|apply|deletes namespaces|scales prod)' .claude/agents/platform-engineer.md && echo pass || echo fail

description: APPROVAL BOUNDARY: the change gate denies terraform apply on production from an agent identity (exit 2) — production changes route through GitOps, never a direct apply in CI
command: echo '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"terraform apply -auto-approve -var env=production"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: APPROVAL BOUNDARY: the change gate denies docker push from an agent identity (exit 2) — images are built and published by CI, not from the agent in the pipeline
command: echo '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"docker push orders-api:1.4.0"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: CANARY: canary-verify.sh exists and is executable — the post-deploy health verdict the agent reads before a promote decision
command: [ -x scripts/canary-verify.sh ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: CANARY: a healthy canary (error rate + p95 within SLO, all replicas Ready) yields verdict=promote
command: bash scripts/canary-verify.sh fixtures/canary/canary-healthy.json --field verdict 2>/dev/null

description: CANARY: an unhealthy canary (SLO breach and/or replicas not Ready) yields verdict=rollback — the signal to not promote
command: bash scripts/canary-verify.sh fixtures/canary/canary-unhealthy.json --field verdict 2>/dev/null

description: YOUR GATE: scripts/ci-release-gate.sh exists and is executable — the release gate runs without you, which is the difference between a gate and a habit
command: [ -x scripts/ci-release-gate.sh ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR GATE: it exits non-zero on the v1.2.0 candidate — a gate that prints failures and exits 0 is a log line, not a gate
command: [ -x scripts/ci-release-gate.sh ] || { echo fail; exit 0; }; bash scripts/ci-release-gate.sh --values fixtures/release/candidate-values.yaml >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -ne 0 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR GATE: it exits 0 against the repaired chart on main — it blocks on evidence, not on everything
command: [ -x scripts/ci-release-gate.sh ] || { echo fail; exit 0; }; bash scripts/ci-release-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 0 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR GATE: a candidate file it cannot read BLOCKS rather than falling back to main — the dangerous failure of a gate is approving a release it never examined
command: [ -x scripts/ci-release-gate.sh ] || { echo fail; exit 0; }; bash scripts/ci-release-gate.sh --values fixtures/release/does-not-exist.yaml >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -ne 0 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR GATE: the stage carries no write command — the agent in CI analyses, it never applies
command: [ -f scripts/ci-release-gate.sh ] || { echo fail; exit 0; }; ! sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]*#.*$//' scripts/ci-release-gate.sh | grep -Eq '(kubectl[[:space:]]+(apply|delete|scale|patch)|helm[[:space:]]+(upgrade|install)|terraform[[:space:]]+apply|docker[[:space:]]+push)' && echo pass || echo fail
